THE VOYAGE'S REAL DISCOVERY: the unit is the (address, TICKET) pair, not the address. A forwarding order is one ticket's record, so the same address is legitimately answered under one ticket and unanswered under another. Two hypotheses were killed on that one cause. Address-level accounting can never close.
